tokens.npc_dota_hero_viper_bio: The malevolent familiar of a sadistic wizard who captured and hoped to tame him, Viper was curiously glad to have been sprung from the sealed and unchanging subterranean Nether Reaches where his race had lived for millions of years, after tectonic slippage had sealed off the Netherdrakes in luminous caverns. Viper spent some time appearing to submit to the wizard's enchainments, hoping to learn what he could of the dark magics the mage practiced. But he soon realized that few spells were as deadly as the toxins that were his birthright. Exuding an acid that swiftly ate away the bars of his cage, the Netherdrake slipped free of his confines, spit poison in the old spellcaster's eyes, and soared out to let the world know that it had a new master.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_viper_hype: Launching deadly poison from a distance, Viper poses a grave threat to whomever he targets. As his various toxins eat away at an enemy's health and slow their movement, Viper simply does what he does best: he keeps adding more poison.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_viper_npedesc1: Poisonous toxins chip away armor and slow enemies

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Attack Modifier}}
** Poison Attack is an active attack modifier, and has the following properties:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Cast Range|CastRange]] {{=}} Hero[[Attack Range|AtkRange]] + {{#var:Poison Attack basic1}}}}
*** Affected by {{M|attack range}} sources of the same range-type as the caster.
** Both {{M|Autocast}} and an active cast uses Viper's current {{M|attack range}}.
*** Has Autocast off by default.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*** This ability component can be applied by other [[instant attack]] sources.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|viper_poison_attack_slow}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
**#* Each successful attack reapplies the debuff or increases the stack value on the attacked enemy unit, then refreshes its duration, and updates the ability values of the whole stack.
**#** Hence the debuff is applied at the first attack.
**#* All reduction values of this source stack additively per applied stack. 
**#* All ability components are not affected by {{M|status resistance}} sources.
**#* Deals {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in 1-second intervals, starting 1 second after debuff application.
**#** Reapplying the debuff between the damage intervals does not affect the current damage intervals.
**#** {{Symbol|a|Counter}}
**# Viper's attack instance.

* Does not affect the following units:
** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} This restriction is removed upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}}.
** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_viper
data.bio_loc: The malevolent familiar of a sadistic wizard who captured and hoped to tame him, Viper was curiously glad to have been sprung from the sealed and unchanging subterranean Nether Reaches where his race had lived for millions of years, after tectonic slippage had sealed off the Netherdrakes in luminous caverns. Viper spent some time appearing to submit to the wizard's enchainments, hoping to learn what he could of the dark magics the mage practiced. But he soon realized that few spells were as deadly as the toxins that were his birthright. Exuding an acid that swiftly ate away the bars of his cage, the Netherdrake slipped free of his confines, spit poison in the old spellcaster's eyes, and soared out to let the world know that it had a new master.
data.hype_loc: Launching deadly poison from a distance, Viper poses a grave threat to whomever he targets. As his various toxins eat away at an enemy's health and slow their movement, Viper simply does what he does best: he keeps adding more poison.
data.npe_desc_loc: Poisonous toxins chip away armor and slow enemies

abilities.name: viper_poison_attack
abilities.desc_loc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
abilities.lore_loc: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

abilities.name: viper_nethertoxin
abilities.desc_loc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
abilities.lore_loc: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.

abilities.name: viper_corrosive_skin
abilities.desc_loc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
abilities.lore_loc: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.
notes_loc: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.scepter_loc: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.

abilities.name: viper_nose_dive
abilities.desc_loc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
abilities.lore_loc: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.

abilities.name: viper_predator
abilities.desc_loc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

abilities.name: viper_viper_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
abilities.lore_loc: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.
